description: SQL getter/setter round trip on a writable copy of the query fixture. For QText, QUnicode, QParam, QOuter, QCrosstab the SQL is read, set to the exact text the fixture was created with, and read again. QNul (text ending in U+0000) and QNoSemi (no trailing semicolon) are created and their SQL read. The Database is closed and reopened and every one of these SQL values is read again.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
